title: Business Intelligence
notes: All six pages rebuilt on PageHeader/SectionCard/Stat/DataTable/chart archetypes with token classes, skeleton loading, EmptyState, and useFeatureGate (via AiGate, ai_assistant). listPage/filterBar/infiniteScroll/hoverActions/detailDrawer/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker/sendMessageDialog are structurally N/A — this slice is dashboards and analytics, not an entity list or messaging surface. Wired previously-orphaned endpoints: briefings/generate, health-score/calculate + history, customer-segments (list + calculate), customer-ltv (via new RelationCombobox lookup on segments page), and bi/usage. workload-analysis and recommendations/generate remain unwired — no natural page slot for them in this manifest's page set; flagging for a future pass. Destinations page profitability table gets a CSV export; team performance and hub cash-flow/lead-source-roi/lost-deal sections added to surface previously-dead endpoints.
